verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a standalone command-line program with stdin/stdout I/O, a self-contained binary option, an official Docker image for producing PDFs, and documented GitHub Actions usage. A community user also reports driving it from scripts to generate Word reports automatically. missing for 10: documented exit-code and error-handling behavior for CI pipelines, and first-party CI guidance beyond a pointer to the GitHub Actions example repository.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Pandoc can be run through GitHub Actions.
If no input-files are specified, input is read from stdin. Output goes to stdout by default.
Pandoc includes a Haskell library and a standalone command-line program.
The resulting binary can be run from any directory and is completely self-contained.
The pandoc/latex image also contains the minimal LaTeX installation needed to produce PDFs using pandoc.
